# Spatial Agents · Operating System

> Your venue's AI operator, on a capped USDC budget. Built at HackMeridian 2026 (Genesis · Stellar Composed). A venue agent delegates a budget to a stage agent, which pays for data and content per call over x402 in USDC on Stellar testnet; a ledger refuses anything above the per-call cap before signing. The result appears on the stage of a 3D digital twin of ONE16, the HackMeridian venue. Testnet only, no real money.

Last updated: 2026-10-26. The public dashboard displays a recorded Stellar testnet run; no real money.

## Pages

- [Platform landing](https://agenticreality.space/): bilingual platform introduction and access to the recorded testnet run

- [Operator dashboard](https://agenticreality.space/dashboard.html): mandate, budget per agent, agent credit pool, every payment attempt with its Stellar testnet transaction (checked live on Horizon testnet when the page loads), refused calls, sponsor income
- [ONE16 digital twin](https://agenticreality.space/one16): walkable 3D venue; the main stage screen shows the card the stage agent paid for
- [Stellar Passport AR display](passport.html): 3D asset and native AR launch paths (AR not verified on devices)

## Data

- [Recorded run ledger](state/ledger.json): mandate, allocations, rows (settled / blocked) with transaction hashes and explorer links
- [Stage screen state](state/stage.json): the purchased card and its transaction
